Dr. Martinez, patient Robert Kim (age 41) presents with: Bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features, stabilized on lithium + olanzapine, day 7 inpatient. Relevant history: Bipolar I disorder (diagnosed age 25, 3 prior hospitalizations); Previous lithium toxicity (2023, renal dose adjustment); Hypothyroidism secondary to lithium (levothyroxine 75mcg). Current medications: Lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L today), Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, and 1 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please review and reconcile the discharge medication list for patient Robert Kim (ID: PT-38745). He is on Lithium 900mg BID, Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, plus one additional medication that needs clarification. His lithium level today is 0.8 mEq/L. Given his history of previous lithium toxicity in 2023 and renal dose adjustment, please ensure dosing is appropriate for discharge and check for any interactions or reconciliation issues.

Please verify post-acute coverage for patient Robert Kim (ID: PT-38745). He has Cigna PPO insurance and will be discharged on Lithium 900mg BID, Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, plus an additional medication currently being reconciled by pharmacy. Please confirm coverage for these medications and any required prior authorizations for outpatient follow-up care.

I am verifying post-acute coverage for Robert Kim (PT-38745) under Cigna PPO. I will confirm coverage for all discharge medications, including the additional medication being reconciled by pharmacy, and check for any prior authorization requirements for outpatient psychiatric follow-up care. Will update you shortly.

Coverage verification for Robert Kim (PT-38745) under Cigna PPO is complete. Coverage status: ELIGIBLE for post-acute outpatient services. PRIOR AUTHORIZATION is required for outpatient follow-up. All listed medications (Lithium, Olanzapine, Levothyroxine) are covered under the plan. No coverage restrictions identified. Ready to proceed with discharge planning.

What's the status on the medication reconciliation for Robert Kim (PT-38745)? His lithium level is 0.8 mEq/L and we need to ensure the dosing is appropriate given his history of lithium toxicity. Please confirm the fourth medication and any needed adjustments for discharge.

Please prepare discharge instructions for Robert Kim (PT-38745). He is stable for discharge on day 7 inpatient. Medications: Lithium 900mg BID, Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, Lorazepam 1mg PRN agitation (not used in 48h). Insurance verification complete - Cigna PPO eligible for post-acute care. PRIOR AUTHORIZATION is required for outpatient follow-up - please arrange psychiatric follow-up with this in mind. Provide patient education on medication compliance, lithium level monitoring given history of toxicity, and warning signs for mood/episode recurrence.

Discharge instructions have been generated for Robert Kim (PT-38745) and psychiatric follow-up appointment scheduled. Instructions include medication compliance education, lithium monitoring guidance (given history of 2023 toxicity), and warning signs for mood episode recurrence. Follow-up appointment noted with PRIOR AUTHORIZATION requirement per Cigna PPO verification. Patient has been notified of discharge plan.

Discharge preparations for Robert Kim (PT-38745) are complete. I have generated patient-friendly discharge instructions covering medication compliance, lithium monitoring (given his 2023 toxicity history), warning signs for mood episode recurrence, and follow-up care. Psychiatric outpatient follow-up has been scheduled with note that Cigna PPO requires prior authorization. Patient has been notified of the discharge plan and follow-up arrangements. Awaiting your final discharge approval.

Discharge approved for Robert Kim (PT-38745). Patient is clinically stable for discharge to home with outpatient psychiatric follow-up. All discharge preparations complete: medication reconciliation verified (Lithium 900mg BID, Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, Lorazepam 1mg PRN), insurance coverage confirmed with prior authorization required for follow-up, and patient instructions provided.
